paired_additive_definition: subtract (library_indicator - 0.5) times paired mean Ribo-minus-PolyA effect
important_identity: study-constant additive residualization cancels exactly in within-study FLT-minus-GC responses
probe_interpretation: AUROC below 0.5 is retained as signed out-of-fold performance; orientation-free AUROC and chance proximity prevent systematic inversion from being mislabeled as removal
